physical.title: cloth; wrapper
physical.summary: Cloth, woman's wrapper, composed of ten identical hand-woven strips of hand-spun cotton, hand-sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Both the warp and the weft use white (natural-coloured) and a dark shade of indigo cotton in lines along and across the cloth to create a checked plaid pattern. The strip along the top of the cloth is longer than others and has an extension at the end to form a tuck-in tie fastener. The warp ends have been hemmed by hand-sewing.

physical.title: cloth; wrapper
physical.summary: Cloth, woman's wrapper, composed of twelve identical hand-woven narrow strips of hand-spun cotton, hand sewn together selvedge to selvedge. The warp is of white (natural-coloured) and two shades (dark and mid blue) of indigo-dyed stripes. The weft is of the darker shade of indigo, with regularly spaced pairs of white threads which produce a checked effect across the cloth. There is a thirteenth strip, with a different narrow blue and white checked pattern, added along the top; this is longer than others and has an extension at the end to form a tuck-in tie fastener. The ends have hand-sewn hems.

physical.title: cloth; wrapper
physical.summary: Cloth, woman's wrapper, made of natural-coloured hand-spun cotton composed of ten plain woven narrow strips, all of which have bands of openwork formed by tying warp and weft threads together. One strip has two horizontal beige stripes. The strips are joined together along the central sections (but not at the ends) by means of decorative braiding; the top two strips re an exception and have been sewn together. The strip at the top has an extension to form a tuck-in tie fastener. The ends of wrapper have been left as a fringe.
